title: avacado_banana_milkshake
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        Avacado 1 

        banana 1 

        milk 

        honey 

        How to prepare :
        In a mixi jar add one peeled avacado, one peeled banana,one cup milk 2 table spoon honey and
        ground them together and serve with decorated glass cup it is very tasty and healthy.
